findings.problem: M0 includes a full month of preparation cost and interest, while prose describes it as an instantaneous investment date and M0..M72 as a six-year/72-month observation. There are 73 full settlement periods and payback output is a zero-based index.
findings.requested_fix: Define M0 as period 1, M12/M24 as period-end 13/25, M40/M46 payback as period-end 41/47, and M72 as period-end 73. Interest is on month-start newly drawn balance before month-end principal repayment; first principal index is draw index + 13. Keep 72-month depreciation independent of observation length.

clarifications_requested.detail: 7.85M is maximum unmet funding in M0..M24 only. Maintaining the hypothetical pressure path to M72 produces minimum cash -20.53M, before rescue costs. Clarify that the near-term amount does not finance the entire observation path.
